decisions.reason: Unlike the other 2018 plugins, which were quickly removed, the ERP interface plugin survived the firm's pruning and was moved up to a page of its own in 2019, which suggests it meets the firm's aspirations; it also fits the firm's core shop-integration business and its multichannel direction, while growing industry turnover and ongoing hiring give enough slack to carry it, so there is little reason for problemistic search to remove it, though the missing website archives for 2020 and 2021 leave some uncertainty.
